# Vendored libraries

These are committed so the editor runs offline. Update them by downloading the same paths from unpkg.

| Library | Version | License | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`leaflet/LICENSE`) | `leaflet/leaflet.{js,css}`, `leaflet/images/` |
| [Leaflet-Geoman free](https://github.com/geoman-io/leaflet-geoman) | 2.20.2 | MIT (`geoman/LICENSE`) | `geoman/leaflet-geoman.{js,css}` |
| [Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated](https://github.com/IvanSanchez/Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated) | 0.2.1 | Beerware | `Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated.js` |
